title: Abdelrahman Madkour: Controlling your generator using Expressive Range Analysis
speaker: Abdelrahman Madkour
talk_title: Controlling your generator using Expressive Range Analysis
description:
The talk will be a more industry/practical look at a paper I am going to present at the Foundation of Digital Games 2022 this summer. The paper details an approach and a interface that allows novice designers to control an established graph grammar for dungeon generation. I am planning to demo the tool I built, and discuss how it can be used as both exploration and specification of the generator.

Lead-in music generated by Sonat Uzun.
